title: Technical English — Course 3, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 13

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When is the certificate session?
tasks.audioText: The materials technician will demonstrate how to check incoming material certificates on Friday at nine. The session will be held in the inspection area, using sample documents only. Students will learn where to find the material grade, batch number and certificate date. They should not remove any original records from the department.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which details will students learn to locate?
tasks.audioText: The materials technician will demonstrate how to check incoming material certificates on Friday at nine. The session will be held in the inspection area, using sample documents only. Students will learn where to find the material grade, batch number and certificate date. They should not remove any original records from the department.
options: The material grade, batch number and certificate date

tasks.prompt: A delivery of metal stock arrived with a certificate from the supplier. The inspector compared the material grade and batch number on the certificate with the delivery label. The values matched, but the certificate date was difficult to read. The inspector requested a clearer copy before completing the incoming inspection record. The material was kept identified while the document was being checked. Reading 1. Which details did the inspector compare?
options: The material grade and batch number

tasks.prompt: Why was a clearer copy requested?
options: Because the certificate date was difficult to read

tasks.prompt: The batch number must ___ with the delivery label.
Choose TWO details that help trace a material delivery.
options: The colour of the delivery vehicle

tasks.prompt: A group of material produced or processed together is a ___.
A certificate date is unreadable. What should you say to the supplier?
options: The certificate is useless; send anything else.
Could you provide a clearer copy showing the certificate date, please?

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of material inspection in a logical order.
options: Complete the inspection record when details are clear
Compare the material grade and batch number
correctOrder: Compare the material grade and batch number
Complete the inspection record when details are clear

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining why material certificates are checked during incoming inspection. Mention grade, batch identification and document clarity.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: task completion and relevant content (0–2); clear organisation and logical linking (0–2); grammar and sentence structure (0–2); accurate technical vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2). Minor errors are acceptable if meaning remains clear.
